AgentRoles.description:
Model per agent role, as backend/model[/effort][/fast]; all but
proofread are required.

anyOf.description: backend/model[/effort][/fast]; effort defaults to high, fast (codex only) spends more quota for speed.

proofread.description: Final proofread after the glossary check; omitted means postprocess.
proofread.title: Proofread

utility.description: Lightweight agents: titles, broadcast-date research, telop selection, live-chat replay translation, and the no-audio fix of a pre-pass or chunk output that failed validation.
utility.title: Utility

image.description: Cover generation; the backend must support image generation.
image.title: Image

AgentRoles.title: AgentRoles

timeout_minutes.description: Wall-clock limit for one agent turn (each repair round gets its own).
timeout_minutes.title: Timeout Minutes

max_concurrent.description: Agent processes one grill process runs at once across fan-out stages (chunks, chat batches); several grill processes each get this many.
max_concurrent.title: Max Concurrent

official_subtitles.description: Fetch platform closed captions as ground truth for translation.
official_subtitles.title: Official Subtitles

cover.description: Generate a stylized cover image (side task).
cover.title: Cover

date_research.description: Research the broadcast date with a web-searching agent when metadata has none.
date_research.title: Date Research

title_suggestion.description: Suggest Traditional Chinese titles at package time when none exist yet.
title_suggestion.title: Title Suggestion

proofread.description: Run the final proofread stage after the glossary check (also --proofread).
proofread.title: Proofread

proofread_watch_clip.description: Give the proofread a watch_clip tool: Azure's MAI-Transcribe-2 hears a span of the video and Meta's Muse ([watch_clip]) reads its captions and scene.
proofread_watch_clip.title: Proofread Watch Clip

telop.description: OCR the on-screen text cards (telops) on the GPU and burn the worthwhile ones in, translated (also --telop or a program's telop = true). Needs `uv sync --extra telop`.
telop.title: Telop

infuse_metadata.description: Write an Infuse metadata sidecar (video.xml: title, description, broadcast date) beside each archived video.mp4.
infuse_metadata.title: Infuse Metadata

InsertRule.description: Copy the next file of a media pool into the deliverable.

output.description: Output file stem in the deliverable; programs reference inserts by it.
output.title: Output

when.description: Copy only for remix deliverables, or for every deliverable.
when.title: When

InsertRule.title: InsertRule

remix_pool.description: Noise pool under <package>/pools/ used by a bare --remix or a remix program.
remix_pool.title: Remix Pool

inserts.description: Pool files copied into deliverables. An insert some program lists applies only to the programs listing it; the rest apply to all.
inserts.title: Inserts

archive.description: Finished projects move here once the stages finish, before packaging; unset keeps them in projects/.
archive.title: Archive

package.description: Deliverable root: burned-in video, cover and titles per project; also holds pools/.
package.title: Package

cookies.description: cookies.txt handed to yt-dlp for downloads.
cookies.title: Cookies

ProgramInstruction.description: Extra model instructions for one program, keyed by stage.

common.description: Added to every stage below, ahead of that stage's own text.
common.title: Common

prepass.description: Whole-film analysis: cast, proper nouns, glossary, catchphrases, segment summaries.
prepass.title: Prepass

chunks.description: Concurrent chunk translation into Traditional Chinese.
chunks.title: Chunks

refine.description: Agent polish of the translated subtitles.
refine.title: Refine

glossary.description: Agent terminology/fact check against the fixed glossary.
glossary.title: Glossary

proofread.description: Optional final proofread of the checked subtitles ([features] proofread).
proofread.title: Proofread

telop.description: Telop selection and translation: which on-screen cards to keep and how to render them.
telop.title: Telop

remix.description: Package as remix with package.remix_pool even without --remix.
remix.title: Remix

inserts.description: Outputs of [[package.inserts]] enabled for this program.
inserts.title: Inserts

telop.description: Translate this program's telops even without --telop or [features] telop.
telop.title: Telop

instruction.description: Extra model instructions for this program.

ProgramRule.title: ProgramRule

series.description: Rules keyed by the source program (series) name.
series.title: Series

channel.description: Rules keyed by the broadcast station or uploader channel.
channel.title: Channel

chunk_char_limit.description: Target source characters per translation chunk (~5 min of a variety show).
chunk_char_limit.title: Chunk Char Limit

chunk_attempts.description: Fresh agent sessions per chunk on transient failures.
chunk_attempts.title: Chunk Attempts

prepass_frame_interval_s.description: Seconds of video per pre-pass frame.
prepass_frame_interval_s.title: Prepass Frame Interval S

chunk_frame_interval_s.description: Seconds of video per chunk-translation frame.
chunk_frame_interval_s.title: Chunk Frame Interval S

frame_max_side.description: Longest side in pixels of sampled frames (pre-pass, chunks, frame tool).
frame_max_side.title: Frame Max Side

WatchClipConfig.description:
The proofread's `watch_clip` tool: per span, an Azure MAI-Transcribe-2
call for the speech (`AZURE_SPEECH_KEY`, `AZURE_SPEECH_ENDPOINT`) and a
Meta Muse call for the captions and scene (`META_API_KEY`), not agent
roles.

model.description: Meta Muse model that reads each span's captions and scene; the contributor tier is the cheap one (Meta may train on the clips).
model.title: Model
